title.narrative: MPCA Program as intervention in Babella/ Rural Damascus to cover the most urgent needs of most venerable families.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe Syrian crisis, which began in 2011, has evolved into a prolonged emergency with profound societal and economic impacts. This crisis, exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic and the 2023 earthquakes, has led to massive displacement and escalated humanitarian needs. In this context, Cash and Voucher Assistance (CVA), particularly Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance (MPCA), has emerged as a crucial component of the humanitarian response.ltbrgtOffering flexibility and innovation, MPCA has been pivotal in meeting the diverse needs of the affected population, despite challenges like inflation, currency depreciation, and funding shortfalls.ltbrgtMulti-purpose cash programs generally achieved high levels of recipients’ awareness about the assistance and its purpose. Protection concerns during distributions were minimal,ltbrgtThe program area target is Babella/Rural Damascus, were 264,287 PiN they live in difficult conditions, which forces them to resort to negative coping strategies to meet their basic needs from food and non food materials.ltbrgtProgram will target 500 families with six distribution MPCA rounds in monthly basis, the transfer value is 1,716,000 SYP (as sectors recommendation).ltbrgtThe target categories:ltbrgthousehold composition and associated dependency income-expenditure disability, and life threatening or severe medical and psychological conditions shocks or emergency situations suffered in the previous 60 days non-attendance at school and resort to harmful or dangerous food and/or livelihoods-related coping strategies are taken as individually or severally serving as proxies for socio-economic vulnerability, towards the lessening of which multi-purpose basic needs oriented cash transfers are designed and provided.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtGOPA-DERD will arrange information and awareness sessions to the target beneficiaries, the purpose of the information and awareness session is to offer guidance and talking points during the session and to harmonize the information provided during sessions for all H.H. The information and awareness session aims to achieve the following:ltbrgt1. Beneficiaries understand the assistance packages (amounts, duration etc.).ltbrgt2. Beneficiaries understand the flow of data within and outside the project, beneficiaries are enabled to consent (informed, free etc.) to the processing of their personal data.ltbrgt3. Beneficiaries assign one HH member to receive the assistance. ltbrgt4. Beneficiaries are able to identify the nearest Al-Haram or Al-Fouad (FSP) branches and aware of the required identification documents.ltbrgt5. Beneficiaries understand their rights and duties related to the participation in the project.ltbrgt6. Beneficiaries understand the redemption process.ltbrgt7. Beneficiaries understand the available complaint mechanisms and procedures (FSPs and Implementing Partners). ltbrgtlt/pgt
